description: Header file defining the rx::ProgramD3D class and related structures for Direct3D shader program implementation in ANGLE, including uniform management, shader executable handling, and layout caching.

classes.name: D3DUniform
classes.description: Represents a single shader uniform with type, register info, and data pointers.

classes.name: D3DInterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents a uniform or shader storage block with register indices.

classes.name: D3DVarying
classes.description: Represents a shader varying with semantic info.

classes.name: ProgramD3DMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about a D3D shader program, such as shader model and feature usage.

classes.name: ProgramD3D
classes.description: Main class implementing rx::ProgramImpl for D3D, managing shader executables, uniforms, layouts, and linking.

methods.name: getPixelShaderKey
methods.description: Returns the pixel shader output variables key.

methods.name: getSamplerMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the sampler mapping for a given shader type and index.

methods.name: getSamplerTextureType
methods.description: Returns the texture type for a sampler.

methods.name: getUsedSamplerRange
methods.description: Returns the range of used samplers for a shader type.

methods.name: updateSamplerMapping
methods.description: Updates the sampler mapping state.

methods.name: getImageMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the image mapping for a shader type and index.

methods.name: getUsedImageRange
methods.description: Returns the range of used images for a shader type.

methods.name: usesPointSize
methods.description: Checks if the program uses point size.

methods.name: usesPointSpriteEmulation
methods.description: Checks if point sprite emulation is used.

methods.name: usesGeometryShader
methods.description: Checks if a geometry shader is used for a given draw mode.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links the program with resources and returns a link event.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program against caps and logs.

methods.name: setPathFragmentInputGen
methods.description: Sets fragment input generation parameters.

methods.name: updateUniformBufferCache
methods.description: Updates the uniform buffer cache.

methods.name: getAtomicCounterBufferRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns the register index for an atomic counter buffer.

methods.name: getShaderStorageBufferRegisterIndex
methods.description: Returns the register index for a shader storage buffer.

methods.name: dirtyAllUniforms
methods.description: Marks all uniforms as dirty.

methods.name: setUniform1fv
methods.description: Sets a float uniform array.

methods.name: getD3DUniformFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the D3DUniform object from a uniform location.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the program.

methods.name: updateCachedInputLayout
methods.description: Updates the cached input layout based on shader.
